headline: RBI Does Not Target Specific Rupee Exchange Rate, Governor Malhotra Says
summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate level for the rupee, focusing intervention strictly on curbing excessive volatility and speculative activities.
why: The Reserve Bank of India manages foreign exchange stability and inflation for the world's fastest-growing major economy. Central bank currency policy sets the environment for capital inflows and external debt servicing costs.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Clarification that the RBI prioritizes orderly market conditions over defending specific levels allows market-driven pricing.
